decisions.reason: The charting bundle is a low-cost extension of the map.apps flagship ecosystem and still serves customers, even though the website has not featured it since 2018.
VueTOC was an experimental mobile component that has not been visible since 2018, so its functionality is better folded into the main platform and the resources moved to core development.
The GIS solution platform is the firm's flagship and strategic focus, so it will continue to be developed and offered.
